summary: Kanzhun Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a Next Day Disclosure Return disclosing a series of on-market share repurchases for cancellation. Between March 20 and April 15, 2026, the company bought back approximately 12.8 million Class A ordinary shares at prices around USD 6.57–7.14 per share, representing about 1.5% of its outstanding shares. As a Cayman Islands WVR company listed on HKEX, this is an issuer share buyback program returning capital to shareholders. The repurchased shares remain uncancelled as of the closing date. Watch for continued buyback pace and any cancellation updates or future capital return announcements.
